title: Aishwarya and Abhishek Arrive Hand-in-Hand at Manish Malhotra's Diwali Bash
excerpt: The couple's rare joint appearance in a red saree and black sherwani led a smaller, intimate edition of the designer's annual Mumbai Diwali party on November 5.
body:
• Designer Manish Malhotra hosted his annual Diwali bash at his Mumbai residence on Thursday, November 5, 2026 — a smaller, more intimate edition than usual, he confirmed beforehand.
  • Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, in a vibrant red saree with an ornate gold border, arrived hand-in-hand with Abhishek Bachchan, in a black textured sherwani — a rare joint appearance that drew the night's most attention.
  • Kareena Kapoor Khan wore a shimmering gold sequin saree with Saif Ali Khan in black; other guests included Akshay Kumar and Twinkle Khanna with son Aarav, Madhuri Dixit with her family, and Kajol with daughter Nysa.
  • The language of the industry on show is Hindi cinema: the party is Bollywood's flagship Diwali gathering, covered this year as a fashion story as much as a guest list.

Celebrities lit up Manish Malhotra's Diwali bash in Mumbai on November 5, and one arrival stopped the photographers longest. Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan arrived hand-in-hand for the designer's annual celebration, posing together rather than separately, Filmibeat reported. Aishwarya chose a vibrant red saree with an ornate gold border; Abhishek wore a black textured sherwani.

Who else was there

Kareena Kapoor Khan arrived with husband Saif Ali Khan — she in a dazzling gold sequin saree, he in a black kurta with white pyjamas — and her sister Karisma Kapoor attended in a monochrome ensemble. Akshay Kumar arrived with wife Twinkle Khanna and son Aarav in coordinated ivory outfits. Madhuri Dixit attended with husband Dr. Sriram Nene and their sons, Kajol with daughter Nysa Devgn, and the guest list also included Karan Johar, Raveena Tandon, Janhvi Kapoor, Khushi Kapoor, Malaika Arora and Bhumi Pednekar, according to India Today's photo coverage and Filmibeat.

The fashion, look by look

India Forums' inside report catalogued the night's dressing: Ananya Panday recreated Rani Mukerji's Shava Shava look, Sara Ali Khan chose a vibrant red lehenga, Janhvi Kapoor a black and gold lehenga, and Shanaya Kapoor a black saree. Among the men, Karan Johar wore a dark velvet jacket with an embroidered lower half and long stole, Vicky Kaushal a deep burgundy velvet outfit, and Aditya Roy Kapur a black bandhgala.

A smaller party this year

This year's edition was deliberately scaled back. "It's on the 5th, but this time it's intimate, much lesser people," Malhotra confirmed ahead of the party at his Bandra residence, in pre-event coverage of Bollywood's Diwali party season. The Bachchans, Akshay Kumar, Anil Kapoor and Ekta Kapoor were among the season's other hosts, with Ekta Kapoor's gathering closing the run on November 7. None of that made Malhotra's night quiet: as the coverage shows, a smaller guest list still produced the season's defining Diwali photographs.
